candidates.opened_evidence: The downstream manual guarantees an older compatible default API and shows NPY_TARGET_VERSION set before headers to opt into a later baseline. It gives NumPy 1.25-to-1.19 as the default example. The C-API manual defines the selected feature version and import-time runtime compatibility checks.
candidates.remaining_adapter: Choose a baseline supported by the selected NumPy/Python toolchain, set the target consistently in each extension module, import the C API, and validate the built wheel on its oldest runtime. Wider API/layout migration remains distinct.
candidates.limitations: No extension was compiled or imported. Specific header gates for every newer field/function were not inspected; documented API exposure and compatibility are the evidence. The exact oldest default of the current 2.5 headers is not established by the historical 1.25 example. A target macro does not make arbitrary Python/NumPy version combinations valid.
